items.title: 3.1.2 Finding Maximum and Minimum Values of Quadratic Functions by Completing Square (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein hum ne graph bana kar dekha ke parabola ki choti ya tah (vertex) kahan hai. Lekin har dafa graph banana lamba kaam hai. Is sabaq mein hum ek algebraic tareeqa seekhenge, completing the square, jis se graph banaye baghair seedha maximum ya minimum value mil jati hai. Exam mein yeh sawal bohat aata hai.
Completing the square ek aisi technique hai jis se quadratic function ko neeche wali vertex form mein dobara likha jata hai:

blocks.text_alt: f of x equals a times (x minus h) squared plus k
h equals minus b over 2 a, and k equals c minus b squared over 4 a

items: Agar \(a > 0\) ho to \(x = h\) par \(f(x)\) ki minimum value \(k\) hai.
Agar \(a < 0\) ho to \(x = h\) par \(f(x)\) ki maximum value \(k\) hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(h\) aur \(k\) ke formulas aaye kahan se? Yeh ratne ki zaroorat nahi, khud bana kar dekhiye. \(ax^{2} + bx + c\) par completing the square lagate hain:
\[ax^{2} + bx + c\]
\[= a\left(x^{2} + \dfrac{b}{a}x\right) + c\]
\[= a\left(x + \dfrac{b}{2a}\right)^{2} - \dfrac{b^{2}}{4a} + c\]
Ab ise \(a(x - h)^{2} + k\) se milayein: \(x + \frac{b}{2a} = x - \left(-\frac{b}{2a}\right)\), is liye \(h = -\frac{b}{2a}\), aur baaqi bacha hissa \(k = c - \frac{b^{2}}{4a}\) hai.
(Beech wale step mein bracket ke andar \(\left(\frac{b}{2a}\right)^{2}\) jama bhi kiya aur tafreeq bhi; yeh \(a\) se multiply ho kar bahar \(\frac{b^{2}}{4a}\) ban jata hai.)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(k\) hi sab se choti ya sab se bari value kyun hai? Is ka raaz ek seedhi si baat mein hai: kisi bhi real number ka square kabhi negative nahi hota. Yani \((x - h)^{2} \ge 0\), aur yeh sirf \(x = h\) par zero hota hai.
Agar \(a > 0\) ho to \(a(x - h)^{2} \ge 0\), is liye \(f(x) = a(x - h)^{2} + k \ge k\). Matlab \(f(x)\) kabhi \(k\) se neeche nahi jata: sab se choti value \(k\) hai, aur woh \(x = h\) par milti hai.
Agar \(a < 0\) ho to \(a(x - h)^{2} \le 0\) (negative number se multiply karne par sign ulat jata hai), is liye \(f(x) \le k\): sab se bari value \(k\) hai, \(x = h\) par.
Ek aur faida: \(k = f(h)\) bhi hai, is liye \(k\) ko \(h\) function mein rakh kar bhi nikaal sakte hain. Yeh hamesha ek achha check hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(ax^{2} + bx + c\) par completing the square ka nuskha (yeh hamari taraf se hai):
1. Sirf \(x^{2}\) aur \(x\) wale terms se \(a\) bahar nikaalein.
2. Bracket ke andar \(\left(\frac{x \text{ ka coefficient}}{2}\right)^{2}\) jama bhi karein aur tafreeq bhi.
3. Pehle teen terms ko perfect square ki shakal mein likhein.
4. Bacha hua number \(a\) se multiply kar ke bahar laayein aur \(c\) ke saath jor dein.
Farq yaad rakhiye: maximum ya minimum value \(k\) hai (yani \(y\) ki value); aur yeh value \(x = h\) par milti hai. Exam mein dono cheezein likhiye: "value kya hai" aur "kahan milti hai".

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.problem: Find the maximum or minimum value of \(f(x) = -2x^{2} + 4x + 3\) by completing square.
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = -2x^{2} + 4x + 3\), yani \(a = -2\).
To find: maximum ya minimum value, aur woh kis \(x\) par milti hai.
Method: sawal khud keh raha hai "by completing square". Is liye hum function ko vertex form \(a(x - h)^{2} + k\) mein badlenge. Phir \(a\) ka sign batayega ke \(k\) maximum hai ya minimum.

Step 1: \(x\) wale terms se \(a\) bahar nikaalein
\[f(x) = -2(x^{2} - 2x) + 3\]
Kyun: completing the square tab aasan hota hai jab \(x^{2}\) ka coefficient 1 ho. Is liye sirf \(x^{2}\) aur \(x\) wale terms bracket mein jate hain: \(-2x^{2} + 4x = -2(x^{2} - 2x)\). Constant \(3\) bahar hi rehta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(4x\) ko \(-2\) se divide karein to \(-2x\) aata hai; yahan sign ki ghalti aam hai.

Step 2: \(x\) ke coefficient ke aadhe ka square jama aur tafreeq karein
\[f(x) = -2(x^{2} - 2x + 1 - 1) + 3\]
Kyun: \(x\) ka coefficient \(-2\) hai; is ka aadha \(-1\) aur us ka square \(1\). \(1\) jama aur \(1\) tafreeq karne se value nahi badalti (\(+1 - 1 = 0\)), magar \(x^{2} - 2x + 1\) ek mukammal square (perfect square) ban jata hai. Yahi completing the square ki jaan hai.

Step 3: Perfect square likhein
\[f(x) = -2[(x - 1)^{2} - 1] + 3\]
Kyun: identity \((x - 1)^{2} = x^{2} - 2x + 1\). Extra \(-1\) abhi bracket ke andar hi hai.

Step 4: Bara bracket kholein aur simplify karein
\[f(x) = -2(x - 1)^{2} + 2 + 3\]
\[f(x) = -2(x - 1)^{2} + 5\]
Kyun: \(-2\) bracket ke dono hisson ko multiply karta hai: \(-2 \times (-1) = +2\). Ab function vertex form mein hai: \(h = 1\), \(k = 5\).

Step 5: Maximum ya minimum ka faisla
Yahan \(a = -2 < 0\) hai.
Is liye maximum value 5 hai, jo \(x = 1\) par milti hai.
Kyun: \((x - 1)^{2}\) kabhi negative nahi, to \(-2(x - 1)^{2}\) kabhi positive nahi. Yani \(f(x)\) mein 5 se kuch na kuch ghatta hai ya kuch nahi ghatta; kabhi kuch jurta nahi. Is liye 5 se bari value mumkin nahi, aur 5 tab milta hai jab \(x = 1\).

Tasdeeq:
\[f(1) = -2(1)^{2} + 4(1) + 3\]
\[= -2 + 4 + 3 = 5\]
Formulas se bhi: \(h = -\frac{4}{2(-2)} = 1\) aur \(k = 3 - \frac{4^{2}}{4(-2)} = 3 + 2 = 5\). Dono tareeqe ek hi jawab dete hain, is liye hum mutmaeen hain.
blocks.answer: \(f(x) = -2(x - 1)^{2} + 5\). Maximum value \(5\) hai, jo \(x = 1\) par milti hai.

Dots mark its highest point (1, 5), labelled Maximum value, the y-intercept (0, 3) and the x-intercepts near minus 0.58 and 2.58; a dashed line drops from (1, 5) to the x-axis.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke graph mein \(x\)-axis se neeche \(y\)-axis par \(-2\) ki jagah "2" chhapa hai. Yeh number \(x\)-axis se neeche hai, is liye \(-2\) hai; humari figure mein \(-2\) likha hai.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.problem: Find the maximum or minimum value of \(f(x) = x^{2} - 2x - 3\).
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = x^{2} - 2x - 3\).
To find: maximum ya minimum value.
Method: is dafa kitab completing the square ki jagah seedhe formulas \(h = -\frac{b}{2a}\) aur \(k = c - \frac{b^{2}}{4a}\) use karti hai. Yaad rakhiye, yeh formulas completing the square hi ka nateeja hain, is liye dono tareeqe ek hi jawab dete hain.

Step 1: Coefficients parhein
Yahan \(a = 1\), \(b = -2\), \(c = -3\).
Kyun: function ko \(ax^{2} + bx + c\) se milaya, aur har number ko us ke sign ke saath liya. \(b\) aur \(c\) dono negative hain; inhein positive likhna sab se aam ghalti hai.

Step 2: \(h\) nikaalein
\[h = -\dfrac{b}{2a} = -\dfrac{(-2)}{2(1)}\]
\[h = 1\]
Kyun: \(h\) woh \(x\)-value hai jahan maximum ya minimum milta hai. Do minus mil kar plus bante hain: \(-(-2) = 2\).

Step 3: \(k\) nikaalein
\[k = c - \dfrac{b^{2}}{4a}\]
\[= -3 - \dfrac{(-2)^{2}}{4(1)}\]
\[= -3 - 1 = -4\]
Kyun: \(k\) khud maximum ya minimum value hai. Dhyan dein: \((-2)^{2} = 4\), yani positive; negative number ka square hamesha positive hota hai.

Step 4: Maximum ya minimum ka faisla
Yahan \(a = 1 > 0\) hai.
Is liye \(f(x)\) ki minimum value \(-4\) hai, jo \(x = 1\) par milti hai.
Kyun: \(a > 0\) ho to parabola upar khulta hai, is liye vertex us ka sab se neecha point hai. Is function ki koi maximum value nahi, kyun ke dono baazu upar hi upar jate rehte hain.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(1) = 1 - 2 - 3 = -4\]
Completing the square se bhi: \(x^{2} - 2x - 3 = (x - 1)^{2} - 1 - 3 = (x - 1)^{2} - 4\), jo wahi \(h = 1\), \(k = -4\) deta hai. Dono tareeqe mil gaye.

blocks.alt: Graph of f(x) = x squared minus 2x minus 3 on a grid, x from minus 3 to 4 and y from minus 5 to 5. The parabola opens upward; its lowest point (1, minus 4) is marked, with a dashed line up to the x-axis at x = 1 and the note Minimum value occurs at x = 1.
blocks.caption: Figure: f(x) = x² − 2x − 3 has its minimum value −4 at x = 1 (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Kya \(f(x) = x^{2} - 2x - 3\) ki koi maximum value hai? Graph dekh kar sochiye.
Jawab: nahi. \(a > 0\) hai, is liye dono baazu hamesha upar jate rehte hain; \(x\) jitna bara lein, \(f(x)\) utna bara. Upar ki koi had nahi. Isi tarah \(a < 0\) wale function ki koi minimum value nahi hoti. Har quadratic function ki sirf ek hi cheez hoti hai: ya minimum, ya maximum.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahi.
(1) \(f(x) = x^{2} + 6x + 5\): \(x\) ke coefficient 6 ka aadha 3, square 9. \(x^{2} + 6x + 9 - 9 + 5 = (x + 3)^{2} - 4\). \(a = 1 > 0\), is liye minimum value \(-4\), \(x = -3\) par. Dhyan dein: \((x + 3)^{2}\) ka matlab \(h = -3\) hai.
(2) \(f(x) = 2x^{2} - 8x + 5\): \(2(x^{2} - 4x) + 5 = 2(x^{2} - 4x + 4 - 4) + 5 = 2(x - 2)^{2} - 8 + 5 = 2(x - 2)^{2} - 3\). Minimum value \(-3\), \(x = 2\) par.
Tasdeeq (2): \(f(2) = 8 - 16 + 5 = -3\). Sahi!

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Vertex form: \(f(x) = a(x - h)^{2} + k\), vertex \((h, k)\).
2. \(h = -\frac{b}{2a}\), \(k = c - \frac{b^{2}}{4a}\) (aur \(k = f(h)\) bhi).
3. \(a > 0\): \(x = h\) par minimum value \(k\). \(a < 0\): \(x = h\) par maximum value \(k\).
4. Wajah: har real \(x\) ke liye \((x - h)^{2} \ge 0\).
5. Jawab ko hamesha \(f(h)\) nikaal kar check karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Tafreeq kiye hue number ko \(a\) se multiply karna bhool jana: \(-2[(x - 1)^{2} - 1] + 3\) mein \(-1\) bahar aa kar \(+2\) banta hai, \(-1\) nahi.
2. \(h\) ka sign ulta parhna: \((x - 1)^{2}\) se \(h = 1\), aur \((x + 3)^{2}\) se \(h = -3\). Bracket ke andar ka sign hamesha ulta hota hai.
3. "Maximum value \(x = 1\)" likh dena: value \(k\) hai; \(h\) sirf yeh batata hai ke value kahan milti hai.
4. \(a\) ka sign dekhe baghair "minimum" likh dena: pehle \(a\) ka sign dekhiye, phir faisla kijiye.
5. Bracket mein constant \(c\) ko bhi daal dena: \(a\) sirf \(x^{2}\) aur \(x\) wale terms se nikalta hai.
